decision.reason: [ev-aaffdc720dda] is the whole upgrade-guide section, and it is one sentence. It says that in v3 the status code reported for gRPC requests comes from the `Grpc-Status` header, so the subject and the new value are clear. It does not say what was reported before, so P2's "HTTP status code" is not in the text. It also does not name the affected metrics, metric label or metrics providers, or any configuration that turns this behaviour on. Without that, an engineer cannot write an exact applicability condition, the open aspect, beyond guessing "metrics enabled and gRPC traffic served", so the provider/metric scope and the v2 behaviour still need evidence.
